<meta>This page contains a dialogue from the "Heaven and Earth" chapter of the Zhuangzi, involving Laozi and a seeker named Shi Chengqi.</meta>

<margin>The word "already" is proof of the exhaustion of frugality.</margin>
<margin>To "retreat" is like feeling regret.</margin>
<margin>Word usage.</margin>
<margin>Not reaching the level.</margin>
<margin>Word usage.</margin>
<margin>Always like this.</margin>
<margin>It is not that he acts because he thinks he should act; "to wear" <note>original: "fu"</note> is used as in "to wear upon the breast" <note>to hold dear or internalize</note>.</margin>
<margin>If one disputes with them again, then disaster will arrive.</margin>
<margin>Sentence structure.</margin>
<margin>That which I practice.</margin>
<margin>The appearance of leaning the body to the side.</margin>

Drinking from the shoreless <note>boundless</note> stream, Laozi remained indifferent and did not respond. The next day, Shi Chengqi saw him again and said:

### Commentary

"In the past, I had a critical <note>literally: piercing</note> view of you. Now, my mind is truly set back <note>changed or retracted</note>. Why is this so?" 

Laozi said: "As for those people of clever wisdom and divinity, I consider myself to have escaped such things. Previously, if you called me an ox, I would have called myself an ox. If you called me a horse, I would have called myself a horse. If the reality exists and a person gives it a name, yet one does not accept it, they will receive double the disaster. My compliance <note>or wearing</note> is a constant compliance; I do not comply because there is something external to comply with."

Shi Chengqi moved with a side-stepping gait <note>showing deference</note>, avoiding his own shadow, and walked <unclear>2 words</unclear>.

<summary>Shi Chengqi returns to Laozi with a changed attitude, leading Laozi to explain his indifference to labels and names as a form of natural compliance with reality. Laozi emphasizes that resisting a name that matches reality only brings further misfortune.</summary>
<keywords>Laozi, Shi Chengqi, names and reality, compliance, wisdom, cleverness, Taoist philosophy</keywords>
